toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":75,"actionability":6,"reason":"The yield data by tier (drops only where awards were cut) and the drop in early-action yield (where decisions were on time) make a strong case for pricing over portal delays, and the next steps are clear; the main weak spot is that the merit tiers were also the files slowed by the scoring bottleneck, and the brief admits it can't split tier from round to separate the two causes."}

output.reason: The yield data by tier (drops only where awards were cut) and the drop in early-action yield (where decisions were on time) make a strong case for pricing over portal delays, and the next steps are clear; the main weak spot is that the merit tiers were also the files slowed by the scoring bottleneck, and the brief admits it can't split tier from round to separate the two causes.
